'''Dannan Kelvan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a second in command onboard the ''Aegis'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the destruction of his homeworld of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Kelvan and the crew of the ''Aegis'' turned to piracy.
